transcript.text: Thanks for being here, everyone. As you know, our retrospectives have been pretty tense over the past month, and we've got another one coming up on Monday. Before I finalize the format and participation rules for the next six weeks, I want to hear from each of you. Kai, could you start by telling me what would make the next six weeks of retrospectives workable for you?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should let you know that I have an approved communication accommodation that requires the retrospective agenda to be provided at least 48 hours in advance and includes a written channel for submitting comments. The accommodation coordinator sent the approval to HR, but I understand Mara's team file may not have been updated yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I want to share something I've observed but haven't put in the meeting record. Over the last month, I personally witnessed three occasions when colleagues were interrupted during retrospectives — including one time where a teammate was cut off before they finished speaking. I haven't logged any of these incidents in the team's meeting record, and I think that's relevant to how we structure participation going forward.

I'm going to incorporate a formal participation record into the next six weeks so we can track speaking time and surface any issues with interruptions as they happen.
